title: NFC Business Cards
description: Custom NFC business cards with NTAG chip options, editable tap destinations, and PVC, metal, wood or eco material choices for digital contact sharing.
summary: Custom NFC business cards built around NTAG chip options for tap-to-share profiles, lead capture and digital contact exchange on iPhone and Android.
Embedded with NFC chip, these business cards allow recipients to access your digital contact information, social profiles, promotional video, and websites with a simple tap of their smartphone.
It can be as thin as 0.38mm, even thinner than the regular paper business card.

faq.question: What are NFC Business Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for digital business cards, tap-to-share contact exchange, lead capture, and branded NFC card programs across iPhone and Android.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for NFC Business Cards?
faq.answer: Chip: NTAG213 / NTAG215 /NTAG216 Protocol: ISO14443-3 Frequency: 13.56MHZ Read Range: 2-10cm, depending on readers

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for NFC Business Cards?
faq.answer: Material: PVC, PET, PETG, ABS, PC, wood, metal. Size: CR80 (85.5*54mm) or customized. Color: White. Black, green, blue, etc., can be customized.

faq.question: How can NFC Business Cards be customized?
faq.answer: Printing Options: Offset Printing, Silk-screen printing, UV printing, digital printing, etc
